author: jlslate
releaseNotes: Vehicle-status fixes: lock state now reflects the last command instead of reverting to 'unknown' on every refresh (Subaru's API doesn't report lock status via polling); removed a feature-flag gate that hid tire pressures; Canadian accounts now use Subaru's native metric fields (km, L/100km) with tire pressures in kPa and unit labels on all values; and GPS location is now emitted from a single source and rounded, ending the constant lat/long event churn caused by two payloads reporting slightly different precision.
